title: Are We Ready for Snow-tonomous Driving? Challenges Toward Robust Automated Driving in Extreme Weather
abstract: arXiv:2611.15217v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated driving has gained remarkable momentum over the past decade, with both industry and academia investing substantial resources in developing perception and control solutions to advance vehicle autonomy. However, these efforts have largely focused on clear-weather scenarios, leaving harsh conditions, such as snow, rain, and fog, comparatively understudied. As a result, inclement weather remains one of the most significant hurdles for autonomous vehicles, often leading to substantial performance degradation in downstream perception and control tasks.   In this paper, we present insights from the EU-funded Horizon Europe project ROADVIEW, which aims to develop robust, weather-aware perception and control modules for connected and automated vehicles operating under severe conditions, including snow, rain, and fog. translated_title: 我们准备好“雪自动驾驶”了吗？面向极端天气下稳健自动驾驶的挑战
translated_abstract: 在过去十年中，自动驾驶取得了显著的发展势头，产业界和学术界均投入了大量资源来开发感知与控制解决方案，以推进车辆自主性。然而，这些工作主要集中在晴朗天气场景下，而对雪、雨、雾等恶劣条件的研究相对不足。因此，恶劣天气仍然是自动驾驶汽车面临的重大障碍之一，常常导致下游感知与控制任务性能大幅下降。本文介绍了欧盟资助的“欧洲地平线”项目ROADVIEW的研究成果，该项目旨在为在雪、雨、雾等严苛条件下运行的网联自动驾驶汽车开发稳健的、具备天气感知能力的感知与控制模块。基于四年来跨多个车辆平台的大规模开发与真实道路演示，本文总结了极端天气条件下实现稳健自动驾驶所面临的关键挑战与经验。
tldr: 本文基于欧盟ROADVIEW项目四年的大规模研发与多平台真实道路演示，揭示了雪、雨、雾等极端天气给自动驾驶感知与控制带来的关键挑战，并提出开发天气感知的稳健感知与控制模块以实现恶劣天气下的可靠自动驾驶。
en_tdlr: Drawing on four years of large-scale development and real-world demonstrations from the EU-funded ROADVIEW project, this paper identifies key challenges of snow, rain, and fog for automated driving and presents weather-aware robust perception and control modules toward reliable autonomous driving in extreme weather.
